reviews.body: The fix looks good...  I think my one question is the workflow...   do we see/think people will do this from the team page?  We currently don't have links to create ai judge or other things from the team page...   thoughts on which way to go?

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. I'd lean towards keeping the button. There is one precedent already: the team page has a "Create AI Judge" button in the members card (`app/views/teams/show.html.erb`, `new_ai_judge_path(team_id: @team.id)`), so this follows the same pattern. The existing test in `teams_controller_test.rb` ("lists the embedders shared with the team…") also asserts a link to `new_embedder_path(team_id: shared_team.id)`, and `EmbeddersController#new` already pre-selects that team from `team_id`, so it's a 3-line view change with no controller work.

If you'd rather keep the embedders section read-only, the alternative is to drop that assertion from the test and leave the partial untouched. Happy to update the PR either way, just say which you prefer.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
